description: Remain flexible / always be willing to change the plan. #flexibility #selfimprovement #selflove
transcript: I live a balanced life because I'm neutral. I do not lean towards one side over the other because I allow room for flexibility. Allowing room for flexibility allows me to be interchangeable with the end results. I am not concerned about where I'm going. I am focused on the steps that I take to get there. Those small steps matter. Those small steps build the momentum to get to the end. I do not get to control the outcome, but I do get to dictate the steps that I take to get there. I remain calm, flexible, and not reactive.
